Usage: tool [OPTIONS] SRC [DEST]

  A synthetic click-style command.

Options:
  -c, --config PATH      Path to the configuration file.  [default: tool.toml]
  --host TEXT            Bind address.  [default: 127.0.0.1]
  --port INTEGER         Port to listen on.  [default: 8080]
  --mode [fast|safe]     Execution mode.
  -t, --tag TEXT         Tag to apply; can be specified multiple times.
  --dry-run / --no-dry-run
                         Show what would happen without doing it.
  --timeout FLOAT        Seconds before giving up.
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
